newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - June 27.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - June 27.

text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.

- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - Hong Kong brokerages traded four billion yuan in foreign currency B shares on the Shanghai stock exchange in 1996, accounting for 42.28 percent of the total turnover on the Shanghai B share market last year.
- The World Bank offered China a total of $2.815 billion in loans in the fiscal year ending June 30.

- BUSINESS NEWS - State enterprise reform has yielded positive results with the asset-liability ratio of Shanghai's state sector falling to 68 percent in 1996, a drop of 2.2 percentage points against 1994.
- Shanghai to stage firework display on the evening of July 1 to mark the Chinese takeover of Hong Kong.
